truths.truth: A milestone close distills its pruned phases into .planning/ARCHIVE.md before the directories go, and `planning.mjs recall` returns a term that exists only in a pruned phase's SUMMARY deviation, with `source` naming the milestone AND the origin artifact - on both prune arms.
truths.evidence: Live end-to-end probe on a fresh fixture (not the shipped test's), both arms. `milestone-prune --label vP.R.O --mode delete` -> {"ok":true,...,"residue_rows":3}, phases/1 gone; `recall flombozzle` (a term only in the SUMMARY deviation) -> {"source":"vP.R.O/phases/1/SUMMARY.md","phase":1,"snippet":"the flombozzle latch tripped on a wibbet range"}. Identical result under --mode archive. `recall wibbet` returned three rows whose sources stay separable: vP.R.O/phases/1/{SUMMARY,UAT,CONTEXT}.md. Value traced across every seam: SUMMARY.md text -> parseSummarySnippets -> appendArchiveRows (cadence-core/bin/lib/planning-files.mjs:1069) -> atomicWrite before the directory loop (cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs:4568, loop starts :4577) -> parseArchiveRows (:1026) -> cmdRecall corpus append (cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs:2081-2082) -> emitted result. Write is serialized under withPlanningFileLock and a refused lock stops the close before any directory moves (planning.mjs:4527, 4571-4573). Staging stated at cadence-core/workflows/milestone.md:109-131; .gitignore holds no ARCHIVE.md rule.

truths.truth: references/execute-parallel.md reaches the sequential branch's detector/fire/status sequence by POINTING at it, carries no second copy, and a check reddens on a paste-back - and both parallel calls name that plan's own pre-merge/post-merge range rather than the phase-wide arm.
truths.evidence: `grep -c risk-check cadence-core/references/execute-parallel.md` = 2 (lines 33 and 43), against 2 for cadence-core/workflows/execute.md. The step points rather than copies: execute-parallel.md:31-37 names `workflows/execute.md`'s `execute_sequential` step and says "restate none of it here". Behavioral: in a detached worktree of HEAD I appended execute.md's fire-rule sentence (carrying `inconclusive`) to execute-parallel.md and `node --test cadence-core/bin/prose-agreement.test.mjs` went exit 0 -> exit 1 on 'PAR-01: the parallel path REACHES execute.md's risk sequence instead of copying it' (cadence-core/bin/prose-agreement.test.mjs:858-887). Range identity check at :900-934 also reddened on two further mutations: collapsing the status call to the bare phase-wide arm (exit 1) and rewriting the range to {PHASE_START, HEAD} (exit 1). All mutations reverted; no tracked file in the working tree was touched.

truths.truth: A check asserts execute-parallel.md gates reporting a plan done on the risk-check status call, and reddens when that gating sentence is removed.
truths.evidence: cadence-core/bin/prose-agreement.test.mjs:889-899 ('ENFORCEMENT, execute-parallel.md: a plan is not reported done while risk-check status refuses') asserts /not reported done while that call refuses/i against the reference. Behavioral: deleting that sentence (execute-parallel.md:47) in a detached HEAD worktree took the file from exit 0 to exit 1 on exactly that test.

truths.truth: `risk-check status` returns ok:false for a range whose record carries a non-empty `matches` or `inconclusive: true` and no outcome receipt, and ok:true once one of adjudication / rearm / gate_pass / override exists under the same corr and plan.
truths.evidence: Live probe in a scratch git repo: real `risk-check run --phase 1 --plan 1 --base <base> --head <head>` over an auth-touching diff wrote {"checked":true,"matches":[{"category":"auth"...}]}; `risk-check status` on the same triple answered {"ok":false,"reason":"risk-fire-missing",...,"state":"unfired","records":[{..."matches":["auth"]}]} with exit 1 and a hint naming the fire rather than risk-check run. After an outcome receipt under the same corr+plan it answered {"ok":true,...,"state":"recorded"}. Implementation: FIRE_RECEIPTS at cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs:3448, structured-trigger join at :3719-3735, per-record range binding at :3775-3781, every-fired-record rule at :3790-3795, fifth `unfired` state at :3838-3842, refusal at :3858-3872. The shipped control is STRICTER than AC4's wording: a receipt must also name both ends of the range (`--base`/`--sha`), so a receipt carrying only corr+plan no longer clears. That is a hardening in the refusing direction and is recorded in SUMMARY.md:58-60.

truths.truth: An explicit user override appends its own outcome event with its reason carried by --detail-file, and risk-check status then returns ok:true for that range.
truths.evidence: Live probe: `trace append --phase 1 --family outcome --event override --trigger risk_surface --plan 1 --base <base> --sha <head> --detail-file <path>` wrote {"family":"outcome","event":"override","plan":"1","sha":...,"base":...,"detail":"the user accepted the auth change deliberately","trigger":"risk_surface"} and the identical `risk-check status` call flipped from risk-fire-missing to {"ok":true,...,"state":"recorded"}. A reasonless override is refused as a receipt (cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs:3723-3732). Prose: cadence-core/references/triage-gate.md:40-47 states the --detail-file transport and the fenced command carries it. self-verify reports no text-transport-inline / -unregistered / -unclear.

truths.truth: Each of the three new checks carries a header comment naming the SHA it was watched failing at, and the check exits non-zero against that SHA on its assertions rather than on a load error.
truths.evidence: Headers: cadence-core/bin/milestone-prune.test.mjs:850-869 ('WATCHED FAILING AT 182d2e1'), cadence-core/bin/risk-diff.test.mjs:757-773 ('WATCHED FAILING AT d30ed50'), cadence-core/bin/prose-agreement.test.mjs:845-856 ('Watched FAILING at e4f95a3'). Re-watched all three: `git worktree add --detach` at each SHA, current test file copied in, `node --test` there. 182d2e1 -> exit 1, 40 tests / 10 fail including both RCL-07 falsifier rows. d30ed50 -> exit 1, 62 tests / 17 fail including 'a MATCHED range with no fire receipt is refused'. e4f95a3 -> exit 1, 23 tests / 3 fail, exactly the three PAR-01 rows. Every failure was an assertion, not a missing export. The three SHAs are the correct unpatched baselines (182d2e1 = the plan commit; d30ed50 = plan 1's tip; e4f95a3 = plan 2's tip). Worktrees removed; `git worktree list` shows only the checkout.

truths.truth: The producer prose writes a receipt the gate can actually join on the execute path, so a fired range that settled cleanly can be cleared by following the documented command.
truths.evidence: The join is `rowKey(e.corr, e.plan)` (cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs:3734) against the row's own key, so a receipt with no `--plan` cannot settle a per-plan record. Three of the four fenced receipt commands omit `--plan <k>`: cadence-core/references/triage-gate.md:36 (gate_pass), :47 (override), :82 (rearm). Only cadence-core/references/review-triggers.md:284 (adjudication) inlines it. Live probe: with a real per-plan `risk_check` record on disk, running triage-gate.md:36 VERBATIM (`trace append --phase 1 --family outcome --event gate_pass --trigger risk_surface --base <base> --sha <head>`) left `risk-check status` at {"ok":false,"reason":"risk-fire-missing",...,"state":"unfired"}; the identical append with `--plan 1` added cleared it. No check pins this: PLAN-2 task 3's verify grepped only for `--trigger` and `--detail-file`, and risk-diff.test.mjs's `receiptLine` helper (:353-357) always supplies a plan, so every fixture hands the seam what the fenced command omits.

gaps.name: Three of the four documented fire receipts omit --plan, so the new gate cannot be cleared by following the command as written
gaps.reason: behavior wrong - the gate joins a receipt on rowKey(corr, plan) (cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs:3734), but the copyable commands for gate_pass, override and rearm carry no --plan, so a receipt written exactly as documented does not settle a per-plan record and risk-check status keeps refusing
gaps.evidence: cadence-core/references/triage-gate.md:36 (gate_pass), :47 (override) and :82 (rearm) print full `trace append` command lines with --trigger, --base and --sha but no `--plan <k>`; only cadence-core/references/review-triggers.md:284 (adjudication) inlines it. The rule is stated once in prose at triage-gate.md:20 ('plus `--plan <k>` when the fire is per-plan') and nowhere in the three blocks a coordinator copies. Reproduced live: with a real per-plan risk_check record carrying matches:["auth"], running triage-gate.md:36 verbatim left `risk-check status --phase 1 --plan 1 --base <base> --head <head>` at {"ok":false,"reason":"risk-fire-missing","state":"unfired"}; the same append plus `--plan 1` returned ok:true. Every execute-path fire is per-plan, and gate_pass is the outcome the common case reaches, so the most-travelled clearing path is the one that does not join. Nothing pins it: PLAN-2 task 3's verify grepped only for --trigger and --detail-file, and risk-diff.test.mjs's receiptLine helper (:353-357) always supplies a plan, so the fixtures hand the seam what the prose omits. By this tree's own stated verdict, quoted at planning.mjs:3443-3446, an unclearable gate is one that gets bypassed.
gaps.missing: Put `--plan <k>` inline in the three fenced blocks at triage-gate.md:36, :47 and :82 the way review-triggers.md:284 already does (with the omit-when-not-per-plan carve-out staying in the surrounding prose), and add a prose-agreement check that every `--family outcome` receipt command in triage-gate.md and review-triggers.md carries --trigger, --plan, --base and --sha - the file whose whole premise is that prose copying a machine-readable fact must still match it. Re-pin the triage-gate.md row in weight-budgets.json in the same commit; it currently sits at 8726 with zero headroom.
